title: Serve interface invariants and deprecation safeguard for pinned models
creator: Elena Ramirez
description: Define and implement a lightweight, enforceable contract that guarantees stable prompt/parameter/output shape and performance bounds for pinned model versions. This ticket covers the spec, runtime validation, CI gates, telemetry, and a deprecation workflow so downstream customers see predictable behavior when they pin a model version. Goal: prevent accidental changes (tokenization, param aliases, output JSON shape, default param values, performance regressions) from breaking production consumers while allowing explicit, documented upgrades.
acceptance_criteria: Handshake manifest v1 exists and is required for onboarding a pinned model: includes allowed prompt encodings, canonical parameter names and aliases, expected output shape schema, and published performance profile.
Runtime validator rejects onboarding or serving changes that violate invariants and emits a clear error explaining the mismatch.
CI regression job runs per-model evals (golden prompts + perf profile) and blocks merges that exceed defined regression thresholds.
Telemetry surfaces tokenization deltas, output-schema mismatches, and tail-latency regressions in Console dashboards and alerts when thresholds are crossed.
Deprecation flow: a documented two-stage deprecation (soft-warning then enforced) with customer-notification hooks is available and tested in a canary rollout.
Documentation and onboarding checklist published for Solutions/SEs and included in the public model catalog UI for pinned models.
Security review completed and any KMS/HSM interactions scoped if manifest includes cryptographic signing of artifacts.
implementation_notes: Add 'manifest' metadata to model release artifact (JSON file signed and stored in catalog).
Create runtime validator library (rust + python bindings) used by serving runtime to enforce param/shape invariants at handshake time and at runtime for incoming requests when strict_mode=true.
Add normalization layer that maps legacy param aliases to canonical names; normalization rules must be part of manifest and testable.
Extend onboarding CI: run behavior/regression harness that compares output fingerprints and perf profile against published baseline; thresholds configurable per-model.
Expose inversion-of-control hooks for product to turn on 'compatibility-lint' during canary rollouts.

Design trade-off: strict enforcement on onboarding vs permissive serving fallback. Initial approach: strict on onboarding, soft warnings in serving until explicit opt-in for enforcement to reduce customer disruptions.
test_plan: Unit tests for manifest parser and validator with edge cases (tokenizer changes, param alias collisions, output schema permutations).
Regression harness runs against existing pinned-model corpus (golden prompts) to detect content diffs > configured thresholds.
Performance tests covering typical sequence lengths (128, 512, 2048) and representative batch sizes; record p50/p95/p99 and compare to published perf profile.
End-to-end QA: onboard a test-pinned model and validate the canary canary customers receive deprecation warnings and that rollback paths restore previous manifest behavior.
Fuzz tests: random prompt mutations to ensure validator does not false-positive on minor formatting differences that are allowed.
rollout_plan: Phase 0 (dev): land manifest schema and validator behind feature flag; test on internal model catalog entries.
Phase 1 (internal canary): enable onboarding validation for internal teams and run CI harness nightly for a set of 5 models.
Phase 2 (external canary): invite 3 early-adopter customers to pin models with explicit opt-in; enable telemetry alerts and 24/7 pager for first week.
Phase 3 (gradual): enable manifest enforcement by default for all new pinned-model onboards and keep soft warnings for existing pins for 30 days before enforcement.
Rollback: manifest signing allows quick invalidation; runtime will fallback to permissive path if a signed manifest is revoked and emergency flag is set.
